as_teriyaki_chicken_noodles.title: Teriyaki chicken noodles
as_teriyaki_chicken_noodles.note: Source uses bottled teriyaki, griddled breast strips, broccoli + mangetout; ours makes a quick teriyaki glaze from soy, honey, rice vinegar, garlic and ginger and drops the mangetout.

as_chicken_ramen.title: Quick Chicken Ramen
as_chicken_ramen.author: Nicky
as_chicken_ramen.note: Same butter/sesame, garlic-ginger, stock and soy broth with soft eggs and spring onions; ours poaches raw breasts in the broth instead of using cooked chicken, uses egg noodles instead of instant, honey for brown sugar, adds pak choi, drops sriracha/rice wine.

as_chicken_cashew_nuts.title: Cashew Chicken
as_chicken_cashew_nuts.author: Nagi Maehashi
as_chicken_cashew_nuts.note: Same cornflour-soy-oyster-sesame sauce, marinate-then-stir-fry method with onion, green pepper and cashews, scaled to 2; Shaoxing wine omitted; chicken cooked 4–5 min (vs 2) to be sure 2.5cm thigh pieces are cooked through.

as_hoisin_beef_noodles.title: Hoisin Beef Noodle Stir-Fry
as_hoisin_beef_noodles.note: Same beef stir-fry strips, hoisin, garlic and ginger, quick sear then toss with noodles; ours uses egg noodles instead of udon, peppers/carrot/pak choi instead of cabbage, soy + honey instead of orange juice.

as_crispy_shredded_chicken.title: Crispy Shredded Chicken
as_crispy_shredded_chicken.author: Khin
as_crispy_shredded_chicken.note: Same soy/sesame/garlic marinade, egg-white and cornflour coating, fry then toss with pepper, spring onion and a soy-honey-lemon sauce; ours shallow-fries instead of deep-frying, adds carrot and sweet chilli sauce for the British takeaway flavour.

as_sweet_chilli_salmon_noodles.title: Sweet Chilli Salmon Noodle Bowl
as_sweet_chilli_salmon_noodles.note: Same oven-roasted salmon on stir-fried egg noodles in a hoisin-soy sauce with a sweet chilli drizzle; ours uses sweet chilli + lime in the sauce instead of teriyaki and spice mix, peppers/carrot/pak choi instead of sugar snaps and slaw mix.

as_chicken_pho.title: Vietnamese Chicken Pho Soup (Pho Ga)
as_chicken_pho.author: Nagi Maehashi
as_chicken_pho.note: Same charred onion, star anise/cinnamon/fennel, fish sauce and sugar broth with shredded chicken, flat rice noodles, beansprouts, herbs and lime; weeknight version uses boneless thighs + stock cubes for a 25 min simmer instead of 1.5 h bone-in, ground cinnamon, ginger paste, no cloves/coriander seeds; beansprouts blanched in broth.

as_bang_bang_chicken_noodles.title: Bang bang chicken noodle stir-fry
as_bang_bang_chicken_noodles.author: The Tesco Recipes team
as_bang_bang_chicken_noodles.note: Same crispy chicken thighs on egg noodles cooked in stock, with peppers, courgette ribbons, garlic, chilli flakes and a soy-sugar-lime sauce; ours crisps boneless thigh strips in cornflour (no skin-on thighs) and adds a peanut-sweet chilli drizzle.

in_chicken_bhuna.title: Chicken Bhuna
in_chicken_bhuna.author: Helen Best-Shaw
in_chicken_bhuna.note: Same method and spices: onions fried golden ~15 min, garlic-ginger and chilli/garam masala/turmeric/coriander/cumin, tomatoes reduced by half, chicken thigh simmered 15 min covered, butter and coriander/green chilli to finish; scaled to 2 (full tin kept as it reduces).
